question: Estimate the size of premium coffee consumers in India (Starbucks/Blue Tokai/Third Wave/specialty).
idealClarificationQuestions: Premium coffee = café-purchased specialty coffee OR home-prepared specialty (Blue Tokai, Sleepy Owl, Rage)? Both.
Active monthly consumer (consumed at least once in past month)? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Urban affluent funnel: total urban → coffee-drinkers → premium price-acceptors.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Round: ~6-7 million monthly active premium coffee consumers in India.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Of these, in income bracket affording ₹250+ coffee (top 25%)

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~6-7 million monthly active premium coffee consumers in India.

calculationFlow: Of these, in income bracket affording ₹250+ coffee (top 25%): ~38M.
Of coffee-drinkers, regular premium coffee consumption (cafe + home premium): ~35% = ~6.5M monthly active.
Round: ~6-7 million monthly active premium coffee consumers in India.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: ~6-7 million monthly active premium coffee consumers in India.
